item.tib: bon 'di ni gsung rab gleg bam zhal bsro rab gnas gzhung chen
item.coloph: ces pa 'di dang po ston pa gshen rab nyid kyi (kyis) mdzad/ de nas 'phrul bon gsang ba ngang ring dang / g.yung drung gtsug gshen rgyal ba dang / yid kyi khye'u chung zur phud can dang / gto' bu 'bum sras dang*/ gang ga klong gi lha mo 'od kyi mdangs ldan ma dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / 'khor gyi zhu ba po rnams (kyis) mdzad/ de nas gshen tshangs pa gtsug phud kyi (kyis) mdzad/ de nas spang la nam gshen gyi (gyis) mdzad/ de nas yongs su dag pa'i (pas) mdzad/ de nas mi lus bsam legs kyi (kyis) mdzad/ de nas zhang zhung a nu phrag thag gi (gis) mdzad/ de nas zhang zhung sad ne ga'u'i (ga'us) mdzad/ de nas gshen po dgu'i rims kyis (rim gyis) mdzad/ de nas lde gyim tsha rma chung gi ring la/ lha mthu rtsal can rnams bsten pas/ mthu yi dregs pa ldan ste (ste)/ rgyal gri gum btsad po glen pa 'gras nas/ bon 'bum sde chen po bzhi dang / gsas mkhar dang / sems don thams cad/ rin po che'i gter du sbas nas/ sum pa glang gi gyim shod nas mar gshegs te/ le kha thun b+h+yoH/ a mu kha mu kha zhes bya ba/ bdud mo la bstab pa'i gtan tshigs mdzad par dgongs nas gshegs so/ kha ltag par gcu pa dang* / bsnyo 'bog dang brtul thabs byed pa'i byed pa'i rgyud legs so/ shel kang ka ram dang bka' rtags rin po che'i rgyas btab nas bzhag pa legs so/ de na gshen sgom chen gyis/ sbrul gyi lo dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gdug la gter sgo phyes nas zhal phyes pas/ khams brgyad gtan la phab pa stong phrag brgya pa bzhugs/ spro zhing dang ba skyes nas/ bzhengs su gsol ba legs so/ de nas 'khor slob ma rnams la phan yon bshad pas/ slob ma yang dad pa g.yos nas grangs kyis bzhengs su gsol ba legs gsung rab kyi phan yon bshad pa rdzogs so/ de nas bdag ngan bu zhu g.yas sgom chen legs po la bshad pa legs so//
